headline: Brent $107 and Nasdaq futures -1.8% pre-market, Saudi Hormuz bypass shut, FOMC hike odds 86%
stance: The Fed tightens Wednesday into 4-5 mb/d of Saudi export capacity going offline. Equity vol never followed oil vol up.

news.head: Saudi Hormuz bypass shut after drone strikes
news.body: The East-West pipeline, 4-5 mb/d to Yanbu, closed Friday after attacks from Iraq. Brent $107.02, +2.3% (~6am ET).

news.head: Core CPI ran hot Friday
news.body: August core +0.3% m/m, 0.1pp above consensus. Headline 0.4% m/m and 3.4% y/y, both in line.

news.head: Altman and Amodei cool the AI trade
news.body: Altman called a 2026 OpenAI IPO ill-advised Saturday. Amodei urged slower AI development on safety grounds.

news.head: Equity futures give back Friday's bounce

implications: The Fed tightens into a supply shock Wednesday. Oil-led inflation is the one kind a hike cannot fix.
Equity vol is the cheap hedge only if the shock stays in oil. Friday's rebound assumed it would.

watch.head: Brent through $107
watch.body: Riyadh has not said how badly the pipeline is damaged or when it reopens. Four to five mb/d is offline.

watch.head: Fed decision, Wednesday 2:00pm
watch.body: Statement, the quarterly projections and a 2:30 press conference. The hike is priced, so the projections carry the surprise.

watch.head: Empire State, Tuesday 8:30
watch.body: First regional manufacturing read of the month. Retail sales follows Wednesday morning.

watch.head: Credit's first mark since the pipeline
watch.body: Investment grade and high yield were last marked Thursday, before the shutdown. Today is the first test.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Hike odds 86% for Wednesday, from above 60% Thursday. Friday's core CPI did that, not the oil.
Oil vol OVX 58.9 Friday, from 49.9 Wednesday. Rate and equity vol did not follow it up.
Claims four-week average 206K, from 207K the week before. The labor side of the hike case is not softening.
sections.positioning: 5-year Treasury specs flipped extended long this week: 88th percentile, up 12 points. The belly got long into an 86% hike.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Nvidia -2.4%, Intel -5.6%, Marvell -6.3% pre-market. Hyperscalers lower too, but by less.
Breadth was thin into Friday's rally: 37.9% of the S&P above its 50-day, 54.2% above its 200-day.
Equities closed Friday higher on oil easing, hours after the pipeline shut. The re-pricing came over the weekend.
sections.positioning: VIX specs sit extended short at the 4th percentile, a 5th week. Background, not a new development.

single_name.note: Avidia Bancorp: new to the list Friday, two insider rules fired, holds its 200-day, 3.4 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Equity-credit correlation 0.60, from 0.64 Wednesday. Credit sat out the four-day equity slide.
Financial conditions still read easy: ANFCI -0.59, St. Louis stress -0.79, both as of Sep 4.
Syndicated loan yield 7.42% Thursday. Bank credit growing 6.1% year-over-year, so the channel is open.

ideas.line: 5 open · 0 closed — no hit rate until 10 (too few to mean anything)
